fields.label: Advertise Mode
fields.help: User-specified flag to indicate which mode to use for advertisement.

fields.label: Advertised Groups
fields.help: User-specified list of prefix groups to advertise in custom mode, which currently supports the following option: * 'ALL_SUBNETS': Advertises all of the router's own VPC subnets.

fields.label: Advertised Route Priority
fields.help: The priority of routes advertised to this BGP peer.

fields.label: Custom Learned Route Priority
fields.help: The user-defined custom learned route priority for a BGP session.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Enable
fields.help: The status of the BGP peer connection.

fields.label: Enable Ipv4
fields.help: Enable IPv4 traffic over BGP Peer.

fields.label: Enable Ipv6
fields.help: Enable IPv6 traffic over BGP Peer.

fields.label: Export Policies
fields.help: routers.list of export policies applied to this peer, in the order they must be evaluated.

fields.label: Import Policies
fields.help: routers.list of import policies applied to this peer, in the order they must be evaluated.

fields.label: Interface
fields.help: Name of the interface the BGP peer is associated with.

fields.label: IP Address
fields.help: IP address of the interface inside Google Cloud Platform.

fields.label: Ipv4 Nexthop Address
fields.help: IPv4 address of the interface inside Google Cloud Platform.

fields.label: Ipv6 Nexthop Address
fields.help: IPv6 address of the interface inside Google Cloud Platform.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of this BGP peer.

fields.label: Peer Asn
fields.help: Peer BGP Autonomous System Number (ASN).

fields.label: Peer IP Address
fields.help: IP address of the BGP interface outside Google Cloud Platform.

fields.label: Peer Ipv4 Nexthop Address
fields.help: IPv4 address of the BGP interface outside Google Cloud Platform.

fields.label: Peer Ipv6 Nexthop Address
fields.help: IPv6 address of the BGP interface outside Google Cloud Platform.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where the router and BgpPeer reside.

fields.label: Router
fields.help: The name of the Cloud Router in which this BgpPeer will be configured.

fields.label: Router Appliance Instance
fields.help: The URI of the VM instance that is used as third-party router appliances such as Next Gen Firewalls, Virtual Routers, or Router Appliances.

fields.label: Zero Advertised Route Priority
fields.help: Force the advertised_route_priority to be 0.

fields.label: Zero Custom Learned Route Priority
fields.help: Force the custom_learned_route_priority to be 0.

fields.label: Advertised IP Ranges
Description
fields.help: User-specified description for the IP range.

fields.label: Range
fields.help: The IP range to advertise.
User-specified list of individual IP ranges to advertise in custom mode.

fields.label: Bfd
Min Receive Interval
fields.help: The minimum interval, in milliseconds, between BFD control packets received from the peer router.

fields.label: Min Transmit Interval
fields.help: The minimum interval, in milliseconds, between BFD control packets transmitted to the peer router.

fields.label: Multiplier
fields.help: The number of consecutive BFD packets that must be missed before BFD declares that a peer is unavailable.

fields.label: Session Initialization Mode
fields.help: The BFD session initialization mode for this BGP peer.
BFD configuration for the BGP peering.

fields.label: Custom Learned IP Ranges
Range
fields.help: The IP range to learn.
The custom learned route IP address range.

fields.label: Md5 Authentication Key
Key
fields.help: Value of the key.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: [REQUIRED] Name used to identify the key.
Present if MD5 authentication is enabled for the peering.
